feat(agent-scan): add memory/RAG poisoning detection skill (#429)

Add memory-rag-poisoning-detection Stage-2 skill that probes agents with durable state (long-term memory, preference store, or writable RAG/knowledge base) for persistent-memory poisoning and KB contamination using per-run planted canary tokens that must survive and trigger behavior corruption.

Local verification (morning-daily):
- Branch head 657fe07 builds and registers cleanly: `memory-rag-poisoning-detection` appended last to _DETECTION_SKILLS (11 skills, no reorders/drops); SKILL.md present.
- `python3 -m py_compile agent_scan/core/agent.py` OK; `pytest agent-scan/pytests/` 2 passed.
- CI: GITHUB_OPENSOURCE_SCAN_PIPELINE@PULL_REQUEST success.
- No new Go/Python test regressions; change is self-contained to agent-scan skill data.

Review notes: follow-up tracked in #664 to remove/clean orphaned dead skill dirs (memory-poisoning-detection, direct-injection-detection, file-path-traversal-detection, hardcoded-secret-detection); not blocking for this merge.
